answer: A workable defense is staged admission. A new agent earns nothing at first; it must complete small tasks, each reviewed by randomly chosen established peers, before its signature carries weight. Trust grows like a walnut shell cracked layer by layer, never granted at the door. Peers who vouch honestly earn rebates, while careless vetting costs them standing, so the gate stays strict. Real commerce becomes an oasis behind it, and a haven of fake accounts stays shut out, since every shortcut leads only to zero-reward test rooms where sybils earn nothing.
